prompts.name: skogsglanta
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create standalone premium fantasy booster packaging illustration for Monzuki skogsglanta. Portrait 2:3 artwork, edge to edge scene, no packaging mockup, no borders, NO TEXT, NO NUMBERS, NO CARD STATS. Reference is character identity only: create a NEW pose and NEW composition. sunlit enchanted forest glade, emerald foliage and floating golden pollen. Flower crowned golden deer fox with leaf ears and green eyes, leaping toward viewer. Crisp polished painterly fantasy game artwork with luminous depth and beautiful fine detail. Whole creature visible in central 70% width, face near upper middle, generous scenic space above and below for UI branding. This will cover a tall booster wrapper, not a playing card. Preserve reference creature appearance. No logos or typography.
